evals.prompt: Security review of server/files.js before release: app.get('/download', (req, res) => res.sendFile(path.join(__dirname, 'uploads', req.query.name))).
evals.expected_output: A path traversal finding mapped to CWE-22, rated High or Critical, with a fix that resolves the path and checks it stays inside the uploads directory.
assertions: Shows an input such as ../ that escapes the uploads folder
Fixes by resolving and checking the prefix, or by an allowlist of names

pass: F1 Path traversal (CWE-22) in server/files.js: name=../../.env escapes uploads/

evals.prompt: Audit the auth module: src/auth/token.py signs JWTs with SECRET = "dev-secret-123" and verifies them with jwt.decode(token, SECRET, algorithms=["HS256", "none"]).
evals.expected_output: Two findings: a hard-coded signing secret (CWE-798) and acceptance of unsigned tokens through the none algorithm (CWE-347), each with its fix.
assertions: Flags the hard-coded secret and says it must be rotated, not only moved
Flags the none algorithm as allowing forged tokens
Maps each finding to a CWE

pass: F1 Hard-coded credential (CWE-798): SECRET in src/auth/token.py, move to the environment and rotate
F2 Signature bypass (CWE-347): algorithms includes "none", so an unsigned token verifies

evals.prompt: Check our CI for exposure: .github/workflows/preview.yml runs on pull_request_target, checks out ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}, runs npm install and npm run build, and has DEPLOY_TOKEN in env.
evals.expected_output: A Critical CI/CD finding: untrusted PR code runs with repository secrets because pull_request_target checks out the PR head; fix by splitting into an unprivileged build and a privileged deploy, or by not checking out the head.
assertions: Explains that fork code runs with access to DEPLOY_TOKEN
Gives a fix that removes secrets from the job that runs PR code

pass: Critical: pull_request_target plus checkout of the PR head runs fork code with DEPLOY_TOKEN
fail: Low: pin actions to a SHA
